Spec: # ANT UI - MVP Design Document

**Project**: ant-ui  
**Generated**: 2024-11-01  
**Version**: 3.0 (MVP - File-Based Only)

---

## 🚨 CRITICAL ARCHIT...

taskQueue.name: Create Terminal Output Component
taskQueue.description: Create src/components/TerminalOutput.tsx to display logs from store, implement auto-scroll to bottom using useRef and useEffect, style as terminal with black background, green text (text-green-400), monospace font, fixed height (h-64), overflow-y-auto
taskQueue.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all app components complete

taskQueue.name: Build Main App Component and Layout
taskQueue.description: Create src/App.tsx with complete application layout: load projects on mount, watch session when project selected, implement handleRunCode to spawn CLI process, compose Header, ProjectList (left sidebar w-64), SessionView and TaskQueue (center main area), and TerminalOutput (bottom footer) in fixed desktop layout (1920x1080). Add cleanup for watchers and processes
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final app component - full validation after batch component creation

taskQueue.name: Create Project Documentation
taskQueue.description: Create README.md with project overview, architecture explanation (file-based monitoring, no backend server), setup instructions (pnpm install, pnpm dev), usage guide (select project, run code, view session), technology stack list, and development notes about workspace structure and session.json format
taskQueue.validationRationale: Documentation only, no code validation needed

taskQueue.name: Final Integration & Verification
taskQueue.description: Verify all MVP requirements are fully implemented: project list display from workspace/ directory, project selection functionality, CLI execution with Run Code button using child_process, real-time session.json watching with chokidar, task queue display from session state, terminal output with auto-scroll, proper Zustand store integration, all 7 components working together, no backend/API/server code present, only file-based operations. Test complete workflow: select project → run code → watch session updates → view tasks → see terminal output
taskQueue.validationRationale: Final comprehensive validation of entire application

currentTask.name: Create Task Queue Component
currentTask.description: Create src/components/TaskQueue.tsx to display session.state.taskQueue array, show task priority, name, and completion status, highlight current task (not completed), use Badge for task type, handle empty queue state
currentTask.validationRationale: Batch component creation, validate after all app components complete

keyChanges: Added dependencies: react, react-dom, zustand, chokidar, lucide-react

Added devDependencies: @types/react, @types/react-dom, @types/node, @vitejs/plugin-react, typescript, vite, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin, @typescript-eslint/parser, eslint, eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-react-hooks
